title: Ada (All the Sages Whose Father Was Named Ada)

paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Ada: Shabbat 17a (Hyman’s citation, compare [Shabbat 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.17b.4)). Rabbi Chiyya bar Ada (Resh Lakish’s children’s teacher): [Ketubot 111b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.111b.20). Chama bar Ada (Emissary of Zion in Rav Nachman’s time): [Beitzah 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.25b.12). Rav Chana bar Ada: [Berakhot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.62b.18). Rabbi Yaakov bar Ada: [Sanhedrin 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.66b.7). Rav Nachman or Nachmani bar Ada: [Eruvin 34b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.34b.16) and [Beitzah 31b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.31b.7). Rav Shimi bar Ada (in Rav Papa’s time): [Nazir 50b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.50b.8).[^2][^3]

notes.text: This is a collective index of the patronymic bar Ada. The consulted Ketubot 111b calls Chiyya bar Ada Rav; the supplied notice calls him Rabbi. These occurrence-specific forms are retained without a global title change or a claim that the listed sages shared one father.

Ketubot calls the teacher Rav Chiyya, beside the supplied Rabbi. Eruvin has Nachman bar Ada transmitting from Shmuel. Beitzah has Nachumi bar Ada with the same attribution. The list collects the patronymic across separate notices.
Shabbat 17b gives Rav Acha bar Ada transmitting in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name. Heilprin gives the same folio. See [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=302&lang=en).
